uncertainties: All video URLs were taken from YouTube's own search-results page and re-checked via YouTube oEmbed (title + channel match). Durations are from YouTube search results, rounded to the nearest half hour.
Language for all videos is set to 'hinglish' based on the channels' usual teaching style (PW/JEE Wallah, Sakshi Vora, Mohit Ryan, Lakshya JEE, Monica Bedi); not checked by watching each video.
chem-aldehydes-ketones and chem-carboxylic-acids share the same two combined one-shots (Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids); acid-derivative depth for JEE Advanced may be limited.
chem-chemical-equilibrium and chem-ionic-equilibrium share the Sakshi Vora 'Chemical and Ionic Equilibrium' one-shot.

chem-p-block-13-14: the JEE Wallah video is labelled 'Class 11' but its group coverage (13 and 14) was not confirmed from the description. chem-p-block-15-18: both Lakshya JEE videos are labelled 'Class 12' (groups 15 to 18 implied) but not confirmed from the description.

Notes are MathonGo-listed Quizrr formula-sheet PDFs on Google Drive (links taken from mathongo.com/dw/formula-sheets and resolved from bit.ly; Drive titles confirmed). They target JEE Main and may not cover Advanced-only depth. No formula sheet found for chem-practical-organic.
The p-Block formula sheet is a single PDF covering groups 13 to 18 and is used for both p-block chapters.

ncert_useful is false for States of Matter, Solid State and Surface Chemistry (removed from rationalised NCERT, numericals-heavy; the old edition is listed under books for theory) and Isomerism (NCERT coverage is thin). Hydrogen, s-Block, p-Block 13-14, p-Block 15-18, Metallurgy, Environmental Chemistry, Polymers and Chemistry in Everyday Life were removed from the rationalised NCERT, but the old-edition text is still worth reading, so they stay true and the old edition is listed under books.

Book section names are descriptive topic names rather than exact chapter numbers, because these books are reorganised across editions. NCERT chapter numbers follow the 2023+ rationalised edition and the pre-2023 edition as labelled.
Many older Sakshi Vora 'BounceBack' videos on JEE Legends (Unacademy) date from 2021-22. They are older but still widely used.
